Hi Olga,

Thanks — we received the signed SOW (attached) and have raised a PO (attached). Our AP team is running into two short timeline constraints on this one that affect our standard Net30 process:

- Internal PO approval will only be visible in our ledger after the April 12 close, which pushes our ability to net-30 the first invoice.
- We’re an EU-registered entity and need the VAT reverse-charge to be applied; our VAT team requires an explicit VAT registration sheet included with invoices.

Given that, would Redwood consider a short ramp to help us start onboarding while AP completes the PO? Specifically, we’re asking for:
1) A deposit invoice that can be processed immediately (we can do 25% upon receipt).
2) Remaining invoice(s) timed so final payment is Net45 instead of Net30 (gives us room after ledger close).

We can provide VAT registration and the PO now (attached: PO-4579.pdf, vat-registration-medivex.xlsx). If you need a credit application or additional docs to extend terms, let us know and we’ll route it to procurement.

Appreciate quick confirmation so our onboarding lead can lock a kickoff date.

Best,
Marta Kovac
Head of Procurement (Medivex Health)
m.kovac@medivex.com

Hi Marta — thanks for the PO and VAT sheet, and congrats on getting the SOW across the line. We want to be flexible here to keep your onboarding on schedule. Proposed compromise below (can confirm after we have the PO on file):

Proposed invoicing cadence (Pilot SOW #4579):
- Invoice 1 (Deposit): 25% of total — issued on receipt of signed SOW/PO; due on receipt.
- Invoice 2 (Milestone A): 30% — issued on delivery of onboarding deliverables; Net30.
- Invoice 3 (Milestone B): 20% — issued one month after Milestone A; Net30.
- Invoice 4 (Final): 25% — issued on project close; Net45 (per your request).

Conditions:
- For EU VAT reverse-charge we will zero-rate VAT on Redwood invoices if you provide a valid EU VAT number and the completed VAT-registration worksheet you already attached.
- Final Net45 on the last tranche is acceptable provided the 25% deposit is received and AP confirms payment terms in writing.
- If Medivex needs a formal credit extension (credit cap increase), please route a short credit request to rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com; finance will return a credit decision within 3 business days.

We’ll also prepare a short amendment to SOW #4579 (one page) to reflect the staggered invoices and VAT handling and send via DocuSign for signature.

If that works, I’ll loop in Rishi to share Redwood’s bank instructions and internal billing reference numbers.

Onboarding note: once the deposit posts we can lock in a kickoff as early as Apr 12.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com
